Sort Period Levels

period_levels_sort.Rd

Sort the levels of x.

Usage

period_levels_sort(
  x,
  decreasing = FALSE,
  x_one = c("lower", "upper"),
  x_multi = c("include", "exclude"),
  x_fail = c("error", "warn", "silent")
)

Arguments

x

Vector of period labels.

decreasing

Whether sort is increasing or decreasing. Default is FALSE.

x_one

How to interpret labels in x that describe one-year periods. Choices are "lower" (the default) and "upper".

x_multi

How to interpret labels in x that describe multi-year periods. Choices are "include" (the default) and "exclude".

x_fail

Action if element of x cannot be parsed: "error" (the default), "warn", or "silent".

Value

A factor, the same length as x.

Details

If x is not a factor, and so does not have levels, convert it to a factor first.

Levels are sorted on their lower limits. When there are ties, upper limits are used. NAs come second-to-last, and totals come last.

Examples

x <- c("2020-2025", "2050", "Total", NA, "2025-2050")
period_levels_sort(x)
#> [1] 2020-2025 2050      Total     <NA>      2025-2050
#> Levels: 2020-2025 2025-2050 2050 <NA> Total
